race.comment: COOL WATERS (7) good type heading in the right direction. Was undefeated in her first prep, then resumed with a fast finishing second over 900m at Newcastle in BM64 grade. Fitter now from the low draw and can finish over the top of these. SPARE (4) demolished a Maiden field at his second race start in good style, then a complete mystery with a tiring ninth over 1100m at Hawkesbury in this class. Finds a good surface for the first time and deserves another chance. DIFENSIVO (5) handy gelding who bounced back from the outside gate with a tenacious win over 1000m at Gosford. Ugly map again but comes here in peak condition. Each way. SHAGGY (1) frustrating gelding yet to race on his home track. Sent north with a fading on-pace fourth over 1110m at Doomben in C3 grade. Gets one more chance with Smyth's 3kg claim. GENEROUS HARRY (2) comes back a few levels for this and can pull out a big run fresh after the latest trial win.
